text: Jesus, thou Son of David, have mercy on me.
Many told the blind beggar to be quiet.
His name was Bartimaeus. He sat begging by the road near Jericho. "Son of David" meant God's promised King.
Jesus was on the road to Jerusalem. He had told His followers He would be killed there. Would He stop for a beggar?
Thou Son of David, have mercy on me.
"And Jesus stood still." A whole crowd was moving. He stopped for one man, and called for him.
Bartimaeus threw off his cloak and came. Jesus asked him what he wanted:
What wilt thou that I should do unto thee?
Lord, that I might receive my sight.
Go thy way; thy faith hath made thee whole.
He trusted Jesus. Jesus made him well. At once he could see.
He was free to go anywhere. He chose to follow Jesus.
There Jesus died on a cross for our sins, for the wrong things we have done.
On the third day, He rose to life.
On His way to die and rise again, Jesus stood still for one man.
